notes: Holy Mass this week is simpler: pick Mass or No Mass for each day, and the day shows Not set until you choose. The All days row and the three buttons above the days are gone.
new: Each day in Holy Mass this week now has just two buttons, Mass and No Mass. Tap the chosen one again to go back to Not set.
Each day shows its state next to the date: Mass, No Mass or Not set.
changed: Removed the All days row and the Mass, No Mass and Not set buttons above the days.
Fixed: tapping Mass or No Mass on a single day did nothing, and a dark band with the words All days covered the middle of the screen.
Fixed: changes made on next week now keep the Save button active when you look at this week.
